act.name: Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019
act.source_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
act.description: Central law prohibiting discrimination against transgender persons and protecting identity, education, employment and healthcare rights.

sections.title: Non-discrimination in employment.
sections.text: Section 9 prohibits employment discrimination against a transgender person.
sections.plain_language_summary: An establishment may not discriminate against a transgender person in recruitment, promotion or other employment matters.
